column1: # Public exceptions: exact lines of published files where a publishable marker is allowed.
# Each line is PATH<TAB>LINE<TAB>SHA256<TAB>marker:ID<TAB>REASON. SHA256 is the SHA-256 of the
# line's bytes without its LF. A row whose line has changed, or no longer holds a hit of the
# marker it names, fails the check, so an exception never outlives the line it was written for.
